quotes.text: def Sz (x : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, Λ n * (x / n - 1)
def Gz (x : ℝ) : ℝ := Sz x - x * Real.log x + (1 + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) * x

def Nt : Finset PChar := Λ.KEPT.erase PChar.one

open Classical in

def wt (ψ : PChar) : ℝ := if Λ.psK = some ψ then 1 else (3 * (Λ.o : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹

def Gm (y : ℝ) : ℝ := Formalism.Gz y + ∑ ψ ∈ Λ.Nt, Λ.wt ψ * (An.gChi ψ.χ y).re
quotes.note: here Λ is a Level, not the von Mangoldt function

def Level.ofSub {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (Ξ : Subgroup (DirichletCharacter ℂ M)) : Level where
  KEPT := (Finset.univ.filter fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M => χ ∈ Ξ).image PChar.of
  ...
  psK := none
  psK_spec := fun _ h => by cases h
  o := Nat.card Ξ
...
def Level.cyc (ψ : PChar) : Level := Level.ofSub (Subgroup.zpowers ψ.χ)

def of {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) : PChar :=
  @PChar.mk χ.conductor ⟨χ.conductor_ne_zero⟩ χ.primitiveCharacter χ.primitiveCharacter_isPrimitive

structure CharFamily where
  ι : Type
  [fin : Fintype ι]
  N : ι → ℕ
  [nz : ∀ i, NeZero (N i)]
  χ : ∀ i, DirichletCharacter ℂ (N i)
  a : ι → ℝ
  a_pos : ∀ i, 0 < a i
  adm : ∀ i, N i = 1 ∨ χ i ≠ 1

attribute [instance] CharFamily.fin CharFamily.nz

def Gm (F : CharFamily) (y : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, F.a i * (Gchi (F.χ i) y).re

def ZeroFree (F : CharFamily) (θ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, ∀ s : ℂ, θ < s.re → DirichletCharacter.LFunction (F.χ i) s ≠ 0

theorem zeroFree_of_rpow_window (F : CharFamily) {θ δ C : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (h : ∀ Y₀ : ℝ, ∃ Y : ℝ, Y₀ ≤ Y ∧ ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc Y (Y ^ (1 + δ)), Gm F y ≤ C * y ^ θ) :
    ZeroFree F θ :=
  lemmaL F hθ hθ1 hδ (windowHyp_of_rpow F hδ h)

theorem UpperTheory.Comparison₂.formB :
    ∀ Λ : Level, Λ.FormB := by
  intro Λ la hla θ hθ0 hθ1 hW
  obtain ⟨F, hG, hZ⟩ := UpperTheory.Comparison₂.level_family Λ
  rw [← hZ]
  refine Deduction.zeroFree_of_rpow_window F (δ := la - 1) (C := 1) hθ0 hθ1 (by linarith) fun Y₀ => ?_

theorem UpperTheory.Top.plugWin (hG : GlobalTheory.GLq.Green) (hV : UpperTheory.Top.VWin)
    (h : Nonempty (Hyps (fun 𝒞 => Closed 𝒞 fun Fm _ => LinkN Fm) DRS)) : Formalism.HC.ZeroFreeAll :=
  h.elim fun h => UpperTheory.Top.zeroFreeAll_of_topG (la := 3 / 2) (by norm_num)
    (GlobalTheory.Fc.shape_of _ _ _ _ (UpperTheory.Top.shapeWin hG) trivial trivial h) fun ψ => UpperTheory.Top.supplyChi ψ (hV ψ)

theorem mellin_Gchi_of_ne_one {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    ∫ y in Ioi (1 : ℝ), Gchi χ y * (y : ℂ) ^ (-s - 1) =
      -(deriv (DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ) s / DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s -
          s * (deriv (DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ) 1 / DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ 1)) / (s * (s - 1)) := by

def ramp (f : ℕ → ℂ) (y : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊y⌋₊ + 1), (Λ n : ℂ) * f n * ((max (y / n - 1) 0 : ℝ) : ℂ)

open Classical in

def Gchi {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (y : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  if χ = 1 then
    ramp (fun n => χ n) y - ((y * Real.log y : ℝ) : ℂ) + (((1 + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) * y : ℝ) : ℂ)
  else
    ramp (fun n => χ n) y + (y : ℂ) * (deriv (DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ) 1 / DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ 1)

theorem level_of_tiedWin {Λ : Level} {la : ℝ} (h112 : ChebyshevInequalityOnWindows @core @Tied Λ) (hB : Λ.FormBAt la)
    (h : ChebyshevInequalityAtWindowScale @core @Tied la Λ) : Λ.ZeroFreeLevel := by
  obtain ⟨eD, eL, ε₁, h1, h⟩ := h
  intro ψ hψ s hs
  have hm1 : min (s.re - 1 / 2) (1 / 2) ≤ s.re - 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hm2 : min (s.re - 1 / 2) (1 / 2) ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
  have hm0 : 0 < min (s.re - 1 / 2) (1 / 2) := lt_min (by linarith) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε0, hεlt, hCe⟩ := exists_small_eps (eD + eL + 7) (half_pos hm0) h1
  obtain ⟨Fm, hE, hW, hT⟩ := h ε hε0 hεlt
  obtain ⟨x1, hx⟩ := h112 eD eL ε hε0 Fm hE hT
  refine hB (1 / 2 + min (s.re - 1 / 2) (1 / 2) / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    (((windows_iff _ la).1 hW).mono (x0 := max x1 1) fun y hy hw => ?_) ψ hψ s (by linarith)
  exact (hx y (le_of_max_le_left hy) hw).trans
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (le_of_max_le_right hy) (by linarith))
quotes.note: where theta is chosen: FormBAt is applied with theta = 1/2 + min(Re s - 1/2, 1/2)/2, after eps is chosen with (eD + eL + 7) eps at most half of that minimum

theorem lemmaL (F : CharFamily) {θ δ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (h : WindowHyp F θ δ) :
    ZeroFree F θ := by
  intro i s hs hzero
  obtain ⟨Φ, hP⟩ := poleData F
  have hZ := landau_window hP hθ hθ1 hδ (windowHypU_of_windowHyp F hδ h)
  by_cases h1 : 1 ≤ s.re
  · exact charFamily_LFunction_ne_zero_of_one_le_re F i s h1 hzero

plain_mathematics.G: G(y) = sum_{n<=y} Lambda(n)(y/n - 1) - y log y + (1 + gamma) y
plain_mathematics.Gchi: Gchi(y) = sum_{n<=y} Lambda(n) chi(n)(y/n - 1) + y L'/L(1, chi), chi nontrivial
plain_mathematics.Gm: for psi primitive of order o: Gm(y) = G(y) + (3o+1)^-1 sum_{k=1}^{o-1} Re Gchi_{(psi^k)*}(y), (psi^k)* the primitive character inducing psi^k
plain_mathematics.window_statement: the archive states: if for arbitrarily large Y, Gm(y) <= C y^theta for all y in [Y, Y^(1+delta)], then no L-function of the family vanishes at any s with Re s > theta (any real C, 0 < theta < 1, delta > 0); the top of the archive uses C = 1 and 1 + delta = 3/2
plain_mathematics.theta_at_the_top: for a point s with Re s > 1/2 the top applies the windowed statement with theta = 1/2 + min(Re s - 1/2, 1/2)/2 (level_of_tiedWin). The expression 1/2 + (eD + eL + 7) eps is the exponent of the bound that is supplied, with eps chosen so that (eD + eL + 7) eps is at most half of that minimum; it is not the theta of the windowed statement. The first version of this file had the two confused.
plain_mathematics.sign_of_eD_eL: in ChebyshevInequalityOnWindows the reals eD and eL are universally quantified with no sign condition, and in ChebyshevInequalityAtWindowScale they are existentially quantified with none either, so the supplied exponent 1/2 + (eD + eL + 7) eps is not constrained by the text to be at least 1/2
plain_mathematics.identification_of_the_two_Gm: the windowed statement is about Deduction.Gm (built from Deduction.Gchi and ramp); the scanned quantity is Level.Gm (built from Formalism.Gz and An.gChi). The archive states their equality through Gz_eq, gChi_eq and level_family, quoted above as statements. This hunt checked the identification by reading the definitions (ramp sums over n = 0..floor(y) with Lambda(0) = 0, the others over n = 1..floor(y)); it did not check the archive's proofs of the three lemmas.
